Title: Dashboard — Stat cards backend (asset value dispatch value adjustments)
Description: Build convex/dashboard/queries.ts: query total asset value from products.totalAssetValue sum dispatch value from today dispatchItems unitCost * quantityDeducted adjustments count for today. Return in a single stats endpoint.

Title: Dashboard — Stat cards frontend (3-card grid)
Description: Three stat card components: Total Asset Value (PHP currency format) Total Dispatch Value (PHP currency) Manual Adjustments (count + Logs Today). Responsive 3-column grid with loading skeleton.

Title: Dashboard — Efficiency gauge chart (half-doughnut)
Description: Backend: query total dispatched vs received quantities compute efficiency = min(100 round(dispatched / received * 100)). Frontend: Chart.js half-doughnut (circumference 180 rotation -90) with center percentage label. Color tiers: >= 70% green 40-69% orange < 40% red.

Title: Dashboard — Dispatch history bar chart (range selector)
Description: Backend: query dispatch history grouped by date. Accept range param (today/week/month/3months/year). Frontend: Chart.js vertical bar chart with range selector dropdown. Tooltip shows unit count. Re-fetch on range change.

Title: Dashboard — Low stock items widget
Description: Backend: query products where currentQuantity <= lowStockThreshold. Frontend: scrollable list card (max-h-48) with product name + quantity in red. Empty state: All stock levels OK.

Title: Dashboard — Top products widget (monthly ranking)
Description: Backend: query top 3 products by dispatch volume this month. Frontend: ordered list with rank circle product name quantity. Empty state: No dispatch data.

Title: Dashboard — Today dispatches widget (count + value)
Description: Backend: query todays dispatch count + total value. Frontend: card showing X Orders / PHP value. Empty state: No dispatches today.

Title: Products — Two-panel layout (grid + sidebar)
Description: Replace app/(dashboard)/products/page.tsx placeholder. Left panel: scrollable product grid area. Right panel: fixed sidebar for dispatch queue. Header with title subtitle + History link button.

Title: Products — Product card component
Description: Card grid item: product image or initials fallback (bg-muted circle) name truncated SKU below name current stock + baseUom label. Low stock badge (bg-destructive ribbon) when currentQuantity < lowStockThreshold.

Title: Products — Filter bar (search type stock-status sort)
Description: Filter bar: search input (debounced 250ms) type dropdown (All/Sacks/Twines) stock-status dropdown (All/In Stock/Low Stock/Out of Stock) sort dropdown (Name A-Z/Name Z-A/Stock High-Low/Stock Low-High). Clear filters button hidden when none active. URL sync via nuqs.

Title: Products — Unit toggle for twines (roll/kg)
Description: Button group on product cards: visible only for twines category. Toggles dispatchUom between Roll and Kg. Sacks dispatch as piece with no toggle shown.

Title: Products — Quantity controls (inc/dec/input max)
Description: Button group per card: decrement (disabled when stock <= 0) number input (step 1 sacks / 0.01 twines max = stock) increment (disabled at max). Manual input caps at stock. Stores in selectedItems Map.

Title: Products — Backend dispatch query (active products + FIFO batches)
Description: convex/products/queries.ts: active products with stock and threshold. convex/batches/queries.ts: active batches in FIFO order (oldest first) for dispatch deduction. Return as dispatch-ready dataset.

Title: Products — Dispatch queue sidebar
Description: Right panel: header with Dispatch Queue + item count X items selected. Queue items: thumbnail 60x60 or initials product name truncated quantity + UOM remove button (X icon destructive). Empty state: No items selected.

Title: Products — Dispatch submission (customer ref + submit)
Description: Frontend: customer reference input (optional placeholder Name or plate number) + Dispatch button (disabled when queue empty). On submit: POST to convex dispatch mutation with items array. Toast success clear queue reset card quantities.

Title: Products — Dispatch mutation backend (FIFO deduction)
Description: convex/dispatches/mutations.ts: createDispatch. Validate stock sufficiency. FIFO: deduct from oldest active batches update quantityRemaining mark depleted when 0. Decrement product currentQuantity. Create dispatch + dispatchItems. Log audit: stock_out.

Title: Products — URL sync for filters (nuqs)
Description: Sync search type stock-status sort params to URL searchParams via nuqs. Bookmarkable filter state. Restore filters on page load from URL.

Title: Dispatch History — Backend query (today dispatches with computed fields)
Description: convex/dispatches/queries.ts: list dispatches with computed fields (createdAt time customerReference staffName totalItems status). Accept date range default to today. Return sorted by createdAt desc.

Title: Dispatch History — Table with filters (search + status)
Description: Table columns: Time Reference User Total Items Status. Sortable. Filter bar: search input + status dropdown (All/Completed/Voided). Client-side sort/filter with URL sync. Single expandable row at a time (chevron rotates 90deg).

Title: Dispatch History — Expandable dispatch items (inner table)
Description: Inner table inside expanded row: Product Name Batch Code Quantity UOM Deducted Unit Cost Created At. Sortable. Fetch via convex/dispatches/queries.getItems(dispatchId). Cache per dispatch for instant re-sort.

Title: Audit Logs — Backend query (filtered paginated sortable)
Description: convex/audit-logs/queries.ts: server-side paginated list. Filters: action (distinct values) userId dateFrom dateTo search text. Sortable by createdAt action userName. Return paginated results + available filter options (actions list users list).

Title: Audit Logs — Table with filter controls
Description: Table columns: Timestamp Action User Description. Filter bar: search input action dropdown (populated from API) user dropdown dateFrom dateTo inputs clear filters button. URL sync via nuqs. Server-side pagination with page controls.

Title: Audit Logs — Expandable detail rows (JSON IP user-agent)
Description: Click row to expand: full JSON description IP address user agent resource type/ID. Single row expanded at a time (previous collapses).

Title: Audit Logs — CSV export (respects active filters)
Description: Mutation that accepts current filters and returns CSV with BOM. Columns: Timestamp User Email Role Action Resource Type Resource ID Description IP Address. Max 10000 rows. Download button uses current filter state.

Title: Audit Logs — Personal view for staff (no filters)
Description: Page at app/(dashboard)/audit-logs/personal/page.tsx. Auto-filtered to current user only. No filter bar. No user column. No export button. Same expandable rows. Back link to /products.

Title: Stock Adjustments — Backend queries (by batch product list)
Description: convex/stock-adjustments/queries.ts: listByBatch(batchId) listByProduct(productId) listAll (filterable by reason date range status). Return with computed fields: batchCode productName userName.

Title: Stock Adjustments — Backend mutations (create void)
Description: convex/stock-adjustments/mutations.ts: create (validate batch/product exist positive qty valid reason update product currentQuantity + totalAssetValue). void (reverse adjustment set status voided). Log audit: stock_adjustment.

Title: Stock Adjustments — Management UI (dialog on inventory)
Description: Dialog on inventory page per batch: reason selector (damaged/lost/recount/system_reversal) quantity input submit button. Show adjustment history in batch details expandable section. Option to void adjustments.

Title: Suppliers — Delete dialog with batch dependency check
Description: Delete dialog: check if supplier has associated batches. If yes: show error listing related batches (batchCode productName qty) disable confirm. If no: show confirmation + POST to delete. Toast + table refresh on success.

Title: Users — Reactivate mutation and button
Description: Backend: convex/users/mutations.reactivate set status to active. Frontend: Reactivate button in staff table for deactivated users. Confirmation dialog. Toast + table refresh.

Title: Suppliers — Unarchive mutation and button
Description: Backend: convex/suppliers/mutations.unarchive clear archivedAt. Frontend: Unarchive button for archived suppliers. Confirmation dialog. Toast + table refresh.

Title: Product image upload — Convex storage action + dialog UI
Description: Convex action for file storage (product images). Wire imagePath on products during create/update. Add upload UI in Add Inventory dialog: drag-drop zone browse button preview container remove button. Max 5MB JPEG/PNG.

Title: Reports — Placeholder page shell
Description: Page at app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx. Title Reports with subtitle. Empty state ready for future report widgets. Matches prototype which is also a shell placeholder.

Title: Comprehensive test suite
Description: Expand test coverage: dispatch mutations (createDispatch FIFO deduction batch depletion) stock adjustment mutations (create void auto-void) audit log queries (filtering pagination sort export).
